channel.title: Tech
channel.description: Business news related to the technology industry, including Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, Google, and Facebook, plus consumer electronics, start-ups, cryptocurrency, media, advertising, streaming, venture capital, antitrust and regulation.

item.title: Signal joins United Airlines, banks in limiting AI agents over customer risks
item.description: Privacy-focused messaging application Signal has joined United Airlines and JPMorgan Chase in implementing restrictions around artificial intelligence agents.

item.title: Jensen Huang is ‘too big to fire,’ putting Nvidia’s governance in focus: analysts
item.description: Jensen Huang’s return has underscored Nvidia’s deep reliance on its founder, putting the company's board oversight and corporate governance under scrutiny.

item.title: Six key questions raised by Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia
item.description: As Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia, questions remained around the board's reversal, Trump's involvement and the tech giant's future.

item.title: U.S. adds Megaspeed to trade blacklist over export control concerns amid Nvidia controversy
item.description: The U.S. has added Megaspeed and six other companies to its trade blacklist over concerns about the potential diversion of advanced computing products.

item.title: Amazon faces FAA probe after delivery drone strikes Michigan fiber cable, garage
item.description: An Amazon drone "struck a fiber cable, a residential garage, and became entangled in power lines during takeoff," a preliminary FAA report stated.
